info.title: RegEx Tester API
info.description: REST API for testing .NET regular expressions. Accepts a pattern, input text, and option flags; returns all matches with their groups and captures. Supports URL-based sharing via Base64Url-encoded query parameters.

get.summary: Return runtime version information for the host.
get.description: Response is cached for 24 hours. Includes a `debug` flag when built in DEBUG configuration.

post.summary: Run a regular expression and return all matches.
post.description:
Applies the provided regex pattern to the input text using the specified option flags.
All string fields are Base64Url-encoded by the Angular frontend before submission but
the API itself accepts plain UTF-8 JSON strings.

**Timeout:** The regex engine enforces a 15-second match timeout; the HTTP request
has a 5-second middleware timeout. If either is exceeded an error message is returned
in the `error` field rather than throwing an HTTP error.

200.description: Regex executed successfully; inspect `error` field for pattern errors.

400.description: Request body failed model validation (e.g. pattern > 512 chars).

index.description: Zero-based character offset where this capture starts.

length.description: Length of this capture in characters.

CaptureResult.description: An individual capture produced by a group that matches multiple times.

index.description: Zero-based character offset where the group match starts.

length.description: Length of the group match in characters.

value.description: The substring matched by this group.

captures.description:
All individual captures of this group.
Only populated when the `ShowCaptures` flag (32768) is set in `options`.

GroupResult.description: A single capturing group within a match.

options.description:
Bitwise combination of RegExTesterOptions flags.
Use `0` for no options.
The custom `ShowCaptures` flag (32768) causes capture collections to be
included in each match and group; it is stripped before being passed to the
.NET `RegexOptions` enum.

pattern.description: The regular expression pattern to evaluate. Maximum 512 characters.

text.description: The input text to search. Maximum 1024 characters.

replace.description:
Optional replacement string. When supplied, the response will include a `replace`
field containing the result of calling `Regex.Replace(text, replace)`.
Maximum 1024 characters.

Input.description: Request body for the regex matching endpoint.

name.description: Match name (always `"0"` for the whole-match group).

index.description: Zero-based character offset where the match starts.

length.description: Length of the matched substring in characters.

groups.description: Named and numbered capturing groups within this match.

captures.description:
All captures of the whole match.
Only populated when the `ShowCaptures` flag (32768) is set in `options`.

MatchResult.description: A single regex match within the input text.

error.description: Error message when the pattern is invalid or the match times out; `null` on success.

replace.description:
String produced by applying the `replace` pattern to the input text.
`null` when no replace pattern was supplied.

matches.description: All matches found in the input text. Empty array when there are no matches.

RegexResult.description: Top-level result returned by the regex matching endpoint.

RegExTesterOptions.description:
Bitwise flags that control regex matching behaviour.
Values 0–1024 map directly to RegexOptions.
`ShowCaptures` (32768) is a custom flag handled by the API before forwarding to .NET.
